capabilities.proof: nautilus_trader.execution.StaticLatencyModel accepted components 60000000000/0/0/0 and produced an observed effective insert delay of 60000000000 ns.
The standard and zero-latency LAST-bar cases both ended in OrderRejected(No market); no later-state Fill and no same-bar negative-control violation could be observed.
nautilus_trader.execution.DefaultFillModel(1.0, 1.0, 0) reported prob_fill_on_limit=1.0, prob_slippage=1.0, random_seed=Some(0); two fresh semantic fee/fill probes matched.

MakerTakerFeeModel used instrument taker_fee=0.001 on quantity 2 at 100.01: one OrderFilled carried 0.20002000 USDT, the native position carried the same single commission, and account total ended 999.79998000 USDT.
Actual CASH+NETTING venue with borrowing=false denied SELL 2 from zero BTC as CUM_NOTIONAL_EXCEEDS_FREE_BALANCE; position_count=0, BTC=0, USDT=1000.
Actual linear USDT-settled MARGIN+NETTING venue with default_leverage=1 exercised native Account, Position, Fill, fee, mark and funding paths.
PortfolioConfig(use_mark_prices=False) is publicly expressible and the CASH Spot probe ran with it explicitly disabled.

PortfolioConfig(use_mark_prices=True) bound an actual MarkPriceUpdate(80.00) and produced native unrealized PnL -40.02 versus +39.96 in the disabled control. Missing mark falls back at runtime and therefore still requires the existing fail-closed completeness control.

Actual FundingRateUpdate ingestion produced one native PositionAdjusted(FUNDING) and AccountState cash effect for long and short under both next_funding_ns and explicit interval modes; a post-boundary position was not charged.

The public venue path accepted explicit L1_MBP, bar_execution=true, trade_execution=false, adaptive ordering=false, liquidity consumption=true, queue_position=false, routing=false, stop/GTD/contingent controls, deterministic IDs, reduce-only, market acknowledgements=false, borrowing=false, frozen_account=false and price_protection_points=0.
An actual default MARKET order exposed effective TimeInForce=GTC and lifecycle OrderInitialized -> OrderSubmitted -> OrderFilled; qualification funding orders also exposed explicit IOC.

Native Account, Position, Fill, fee, funding, valuation and PnL paths exist, and no replacement was built. However, the mandatory external LAST-bar causal MARKET Fill path is not satisfiable as tested; resolving it by invented BID/ASK state or a project matcher would change semantics or introduce a forbidden replacement.
